title: Every tool result becomes an artifact, in order, before the turn's own answer
rationale: A tool RESULT is work the agent did on the client's behalf and is therefore task output: it becomes an artifact unconditionally, not behind a flag, because an interop transport whose observability depends on an operator having switched it on is one a partner cannot rely on. A tool CALL is not output — it is an intention — so it produces no canonical frame at all; a mapping that emitted one would double-count every tool use. Structured tool output rides as a real application/json part alongside the text so a client decodes a document rather than re-parsing a string, and the artifacts arrive in the order the tools ran, with the turn's own answer last.
